mandate.title: Correspondence triage mandate
mandate.description: The agent routes correspondence and drafts replies. A caseworker commits the action.
mandate.body: Em’s composite example starts at **Tier 3 · Enhanced**.[^baseline] The agent classifies correspondence and drafts a suggested reply from approved templates.[^scope] A caseworker commits the action.[^decision] Sending and deciding cases are outside the mandate.[^exclusions]

send-variant.title: Give the agent the send action
send-variant.description: Sending introduces an irreversible effect and moves the example to Tier 4 · Critical.
send-variant.body: In Em’s published variant, the proposed change is to let the agent send the reply itself. Em treats the new effect as irreversible, moves the composite example to **Tier 4 · Critical**, sets the variant’s cap at **L1 · Draft only**, and requires shadow mode.[^send] This records the published outcome for the example.

draft-only.title: Keep the draft-only limit
draft-only.description: For this variant, a person edits and commits every output.
draft-only.body: Em’s worked example keeps the autonomy cap at L1 for the send variant. A person edits and commits each output.[^send] In the baseline mandate, the caseworker commits the action.[^decision]

shadow-mode.title: Test in shadow mode
shadow-mode.description: The worked send variant requires shadow mode.
shadow-mode.body: Em’s worked send variant requires shadow mode.[^send] For this pilot, show the agent proposing replies for comparison with human handling while the send action is unavailable. Retain evidence of how the draft-only boundary and escalation worked. These are illustrative test ideas.

evidence-brief.title: Prepare the evidence for review
evidence-brief.description: Record what changed, the proposed controls, test evidence and the open local decision.
evidence-brief.body: Em’s playbook calls for reassessment when new actions or permissions are introduced.[^reassessment] The pilot evidence brief asks for the changed mandate, results of draft-only and shadow-mode tests, unresolved issues, and the named local reviewer’s decision. This is an illustrative template. The bundle contains no local appointment, approval or real correspondence.
